        /// <summary>Awaits the pending handlers of a parallel publish and throws every failure, in handler order.</summary>
        [global::System.Runtime.CompilerServices.AsyncMethodBuilder(typeof(global::System.Runtime.CompilerServices.PoolingAsyncValueTaskMethodBuilder))]
        private static async global::System.Threading.Tasks.ValueTask __WhenAllHandlers(global::System.Threading.Tasks.Task[] tasks)
        {
            try
            {
                await global::System.Threading.Tasks.Task.WhenAll(tasks).ConfigureAwait(false);
            }
            catch (global::System.Exception)
            {
                // Every failure is collected below, in handler order.
            }

            global::System.Collections.Generic.List<global::System.Exception>? exceptions = null;
            foreach (var task in tasks)
            {
                if (task.IsFaulted)
                {
                    (exceptions ??= new()).AddRange(task.Exception!.InnerExceptions);
                }
                else if (task.IsCanceled)
                {
                    try
                    {
                        task.GetAwaiter().GetResult();
                    }
                    catch (global::System.Exception exception)
                    {
                        (exceptions ??= new()).Add(exception);
                    }
                }
            }

            if (exceptions is not null)
            {
                throw new global::System.AggregateException(exceptions);
            }
        }
